spotlight.title: Ratnakīrti
spotlight.summary: [New Entry by Patrick McAllister on August 26, 2026.] Ratnakīrti was a Buddhist scholar at Vikramaśīla monastery during the first half of the eleventh century CE. Today, he is best known for ten philosophical works on metaphysical, epistemological, logical and Buddhological topics. These ten works have survived in their original language, Sanskrit.…

digest.title: NIST Researchers Supersize Quantum Technology to Help Detect Faint Photons
digest.summary: Our everyday life is flooded with photons, the quantum building blocks of light. For cutting-edge technology, from quantum computing to deep-tissue imaging, detecting every single photon counts. “Photons carry information,” said Kristen Parzuchowski

digest.title: JWST Images The Lion's Head Nebula
digest.summary: Are we looking at the future of our Sun? The James Webb Space Telescope captured today’s composite image of the Lion’s Head Nebula (NGC 2392) with its NIRCam and MIRI instruments. The Lion’s Head Nebula is the remnant of a Sun-like star. This star was unable to sustain the nuclear fusion in its core needed to remain stable. It began to shed layers of gas…
